title: Cover undo label collisions after preview
body:
## Outcome

Adds confirmation-time coverage for the approved REC reconstruction slice 0 undo guard. The runtime guard already exists in base commit `b86cec9`; this PR does not duplicate or change it. This is not full CON-07 reconstruction.

## Coverage

The real-Git `[CON-12, GIT-04]` regression obtains an undo preview, adds a foreign commit with the same `Tenet-Work` label, and confirms undo. It requires `undo-conflict`, no inverse execution, unchanged source/index/history, no `undoneBy`, and no new revert contract.

## Validation

Exact head `b73887cb1f13e798009f6cf8c4b6193217022ee2` passed [push run 42406328133](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42406328133) and [PR run 42406344599, attempt 2](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42406344599): full CI and real-repository built-bundle UAT on Node 24 and 22.12 on Ubuntu/macOS, plus Windows portability. First PR attempt failed a nested watcher calibration timeout; cause unconfirmed, unchanged same-head retry passed, no guard or timeout weakened.

Local static/build/artifact gates and staged/outgoing privacy checks passed; privacy scans are heuristic, not proof. Local Windows mutating workflows remain intentionally unsupported. No installed-host observation or release qualification is claimed.

No schema, budget or kernel behavior changes. Changelog records validation as pending at commit time; the exact-head results above supersede that status. Local plan stays ignored. Predicted CHANGELOG conflict with capacity #9 awaits prerequisite merge and owner-authorized branch update; no immediate rewrite.

## Review and merge gates

This changes executable TypeScript test content. Conservatively retain the solo 72-hour review window under PRD ENG-11 / Tech Spec §18; green CI does not waive elapsed time or independent review. Opened 2026-11-07 19:28 UTC: earliest solo-window completion is 2026-11-10 19:28 UTC. The owner merges; this session will not merge or push main.
